I've saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com). It hasn't been sent, so someone still needs to read it over and send it.

- **Subject:** "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Body:** It gives the rate of $2,101 a seat and says you approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis to keep the figure to the people who need it.

As CFO, your approval is enough to send this rate to Hollis, and the mail stays inside pemberline.com. I didn't check the figure against Marcus's original because I couldn't find any Thornbury files. The draft uses the figure exactly as you gave it.
